description.value: Village Food Markets is an award-winning independent supermarket in Sooke Centre Mall, locally owned and operated, and a multiple-time Canadian Independent Grocer of the Year. The store offers a full deli and butcher shop, in-house bakery, expanded organic produce section, and Chester's Chicken fried chicken takeout. Touring cyclists passing through Sooke will find a comprehensive grocery resupply with strong local and Canadian product focus.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Village Food Markets is an active, full-service independent supermarket in Sooke Centre Mall at 6661 Sooke Road, with phone 250.642.2734 matching OSM. The site describes a deli, butcher, bakery, Chester's Chicken hot food, and produce department — all confirming grocery and hot food amenities. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, ice, vending machines, camping fuel, or cycling infrastructure anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag shows 07:00-21:00 but website states 'Open Daily 7am – 9pm', a one-hour discrepancy; website value preferred as more authoritative and recently updated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, full-service independent grocery store on the Sooke Road cycling corridor — a clear resupply stop for touring cyclists heading west on Vancouver Island.
enrichment_extras.notes: Unit 103 appears in OSM addr:unit tag but is not prominent on the website; the mall address 6661 Sooke Road is the commonly used address.

Hot food.detail: Chester's Chicken fried chicken takeout and deli grab-and-go items explicitly listed as services on the website

wow_evidence: multiple-time Canadian Independent Grocer of the Year
